title: Episcopacy

inlines.v: EPIS'COPACY, noun [Latin episcopatus; Gr. to inspect, to see. See Bishop.] Government of the church by bishops; that form of ecclesiastical government, in which diocesan bishops are established, as distinct from and superior to priests or presbyters.
